resources.string: The top panel stays off and dialogs, notifications, the volume bar and messages open on the bottom screen.
While the swivel is open, the top panel is powered off and anything that would open there appears on the bottom screen instead (needs System Framework).
A small translucent tab at the top right of the bottom screen shows Wi-Fi, mobile data, the notification count and battery %. Covers nothing, takes no input.
Hide the status bar in fullscreen apps
Fullscreen apps such as Daijishou and games hide the status label at the top.
A slim vertical volume bar on the right edge of the screen in use, drawn by the system (no extra permission). Never takes input.
Use auto-rotate toggle as rotation switch
Auto-rotate OFF locks landscape (90°), ON locks portrait. The switch applies instantly; the first time only, check \"System Framework\" in LSPosed and reboot.
Keep the stock LG second launcher
Enable the module, pick \"Select recommended\" from the ⋮ menu of its scope, then reboot: every feature applies.
Needed only after enabling the module or changing its scope. Switches above apply instantly.
Writes the errors the module runs into to the LSPosed log. Turn it on only while tracking down a problem. Hooks that fail to install are always logged.
On: each USB connection comes up as charging only. Off: file transfer (MTP), as stock. You can still pick another mode by hand after connecting.
A feature you turned on is not loaded in this boot yet. In LSPosed, pick \"Select recommended\" in GoDaijishou\'s scope, then reboot.
Could not open LSPosed. Tap the LSPosed notification instead.
Needs the System Framework hook: check it in LSPosed and reboot once.
Holding the power key opens the power menu as an overlay in the middle of the screen. Turn off Classic PowerMenu to avoid two menus.
Eco: lowest clocks, least heat. Normal: a bit under stock. Turbo: full clocks, less throttling. Needs root (Magisk).
No root: allow GoDaijishou in Magisk
Skips LG\'s swivel-mode camera notices (camera may look cropped, swivel down to use the camera). Tick com.lge.popupcamera in the LSPosed scope.
Draws the gesture pill at 2/3 thickness and 2/3 length. Color and gestures stay as they are. Check System UI in LSPosed.
Removes the hide-keyboard / switcher row under the keyboard, leaving only the gesture bar\'s height. Check System UI and your keyboard app in LSPosed, then reboot.
Passkeys and logins use your PIN instead of a fingerprint. Enrolled fingerprints are kept. Applies after a reboot.
This feature works once these are checked in the GoDaijishou module\'s scope in LSPosed, followed by a reboot.\n\n%1$s
